user.title: Configure the release audit
user.description: The GitHub token and notification action are optional. Without a token, repositories are checked in batches.

data.max_requests_per_run: GitHub request budget per unauthenticated run

data_description.github_token: Optional read-only token. It increases the API limit and allows a full audit in one run.
data_description.notify_service: Optional action such as notify.mobile_app_your_phone. Leave empty to disable push notifications.
data_description.excluded_repositories: Optional GitHub repositories to skip, one owner/repository per line.
data_description.daily_hour: Local hour from 0 to 23. The audit starts at 15 minutes past the hour.
data_description.max_requests_per_run: Maximum API request budget without a token. Repository metadata, Releases and fallback Tags can use up to three requests per repository.

init.title: Audit settings
init.description: Leave the token field empty to keep the current token. Enable token removal only when you want to delete it.

data.max_requests_per_run: GitHub request budget per unauthenticated run

data_description.github_token: Optional. Enter a value only to replace the saved token.

data_description.daily_hour: Local hour from 0 to 23. The audit starts at 15 minutes past the hour.

run_audit.name: Run custom component audit
run_audit.description: Checks GitHub releases for integrations installed through HACS.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Daily checks the next batch, full checks every possible repository, and digest also sends the accumulated summary.

notify.name: Send notification
notify.description: Send important results through the configured notification action.

acknowledge_finding.name: Acknowledge finding
acknowledge_finding.description: Mark an active finding as reviewed while keeping it visible.

finding_id.name: Finding ID
finding_id.description: Stable finding_id exposed by the Active findings sensor.

snooze_finding.name: Snooze finding
snooze_finding.description: Temporarily hide an active finding from the attention indicator.

finding_id.name: Finding ID
finding_id.description: Stable finding_id exposed by the Active findings sensor.

days.name: Snooze duration
days.description: Reopen the finding after 7 or 30 days.

ignore_finding.name: Ignore finding
ignore_finding.description: Hide this exact finding until its release version or repository condition changes.

finding_id.name: Finding ID
finding_id.description: Stable finding_id exposed by the Active findings sensor.

restore_finding.name: Restore finding
restore_finding.description: Return an acknowledged, snoozed or ignored finding to the new state.

finding_id.name: Finding ID
finding_id.description: Stable finding_id exposed by the Active findings sensor.

not_configured.message: HA Auditor is not configured. Add it from Settings > Devices & services.

finding_not_found.message: The requested finding no longer exists. Refresh the Active findings sensor and try again.

finding_not_active.message: The requested finding is not active and cannot be reviewed.

github_token_invalid.title: GitHub token is invalid or expired

init.title: Repair GitHub access
init.description: GitHub rejected the configured token. Enter a replacement token or remove the rejected token to continue without authentication.

data_description.github_token: Optional when token removal is enabled. Use a read-only token; HA Auditor does not display or log it.
data_description.clear_github_token: Continue with lower-limit unauthenticated batches instead of saving a replacement.

error.cannot_connect: GitHub could not be reached. Try again later.
error.token_required: Enter a replacement token or enable token removal.

abort.entry_missing: The HA Auditor configuration entry no longer exists.
